title: Tunbridge Wells Halifax Memorial
location_name: St James's Church, Royal Tunbridge Wells, Kent
crew_summary: Crew — details not recorded in source
memorial_details: Small altar-mounted plaque to F/S H.A. Ross-Thomson (pilot) inside St James's Church, Royal Tunbridge Wells, Kent.
narrative: Halifax W7882 of 102 Squadron, coded DY-P, departed Pocklington at 1853 on 2 February 1943 for Cologne. Flight Sergeant H.A. Ross-Thomson, the pilot, is commemorated on a small altar-mounted plaque in St James's Church, Royal Tunbridge Wells. The memorial was recorded by the IWM War Memorials Register.
